issues.issue: Was the PRRA officer's finding of no well-founded fear of persecution based on mental illness and gender reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: PRRA officer unreasonably found no well-founded fear of persecution based on mental illness and gender; removal would exacerbate PTSD; discrimination against mental illness and gender exists.
issues.respondent_position: Officer reasonably rejected submissions due to unclear PTSD origin, lack of proof of abuses, and found no personal risk from gender discrimination; treatment availability issues not valid refugee grounds.
issues.result_text: Dismissing application because officer's analysis was reasonable and based on established legal principles.
